primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.
We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.
Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.
